strongest_confirmed_findings: March cloud amendment commits at least $5.6B over ten years through February 29 2036; annual minima $268M-$979M; provider unnamed.
Q2 hosting expense increase was $89M in cost of revenue and $25M in R&D, versus prior year.
Q2 operating cash flow $1.216B, cash/equivalents/Treasuries about $9.225B and zero debt at June 30; gross margin 85%.
investable_read_through: Palantir participates in AI infrastructure demand through cloud purchases and software distribution. Long-term minimum spend can reduce flexibility as unit costs change, but liquidity and cash generation currently offset a financing-stress interpretation. Nebius partnership may widen open-model distribution without proving quantified offtake.
contradictions_to_prior_assumptions: Low owned capex does not mean no infrastructure commitments.
September Nebius partnership cannot be assumed to be the March unnamed cloud contract.
Neither total software revenue nor commercial revenue is an AI-only compute numerator; supplier PUE is not_applicable.
unresolved_questions: Incremental AI/AIP-only recognized software revenue, allocation between Palantir-hosted and customer-hosted workloads, and separately identified pass-through compute/hardware are not disclosed.
Matching-period active customer IT MW, GPU/model counts, activation dates, physical utilization and energy allocation are not disclosed; no period-average capacity can be reconstructed.
Customer-site total and IT energy, measured operational PUE, and matched technology/geography proxy inputs are not disclosed. Software supplier PUE is not_applicable.

Full March cloud amendment, provider identity, eligible-service definitions, annual schedule, rate resets, credits, shortfall relief, unused-spend carryforward, paid-to-date and remaining minimum commitments are not public in reviewed documents.

Nebius agreement economics, revenue share, committed MW, GPU ownership, acceptance terms, integration completion date, PPA/SPV/guarantee details and financing obligations are not stated in the reviewed announcement.
